A 200 with the usage block missing. Anthropic's own API always returns one;
a proxy or gateway in front of --base-url does not always pass it through.

Settled at the pessimistic reservation and marked usage_estimated, never at
zero. A zero settlement is what makes a dollar cap unenforceable, and the
adapter — not core — stamps the number, because core derives spend from the
Response and the store persists that same derivation.
